Getting weather data for epidemiological modelling from the Australian Bueru
of Meteorology.

## Weather observations  

Get recent observations in Queensland Australia.

```{r}
dl_loc <- tempdir()

w_dat <- get_bom(ftp_url = "ftp://ftp.bom.gov.au/anon/",
                 folder = "gen/fwo/",
                 product_id = "IDQ60910",
                 download_location = dl_loc)
```


```{r}
w_dat
extract_bom_obs(w_dat)
```
